personality: 3 Editorial Mobile LIGHT (with iOS-Native Clean clinical spacing)
personality_one_liner: A calm, professional, offline-first clinical movement screening tool designed with warm ivory tones, precise typography, and uncompromising medical responsibility.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical editorial rhythm with 16-24pt card padding and strict touch targets >= 44pt

do's: Use solid warm ivory and stone surfaces
dont's: No neon blur or purple gradients

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Launch hub showing offline system status (Camera, Storage, ML, BLE) and direct path to New Assessment, History, and Settings.

states.loading: Checking local Room database and CameraX services...
states.error: Local storage or camera initialization warning.

screens.layout: Vertical scroll with prominent brand header, quick action card for NEW ASSESSMENT, secondary grid for Patients, History, Settings, and real-time system status footer.

screens.name: PatientDetails
screens.purpose: Collects patient identity, anthropometric data (age, sex, height, weight), and target body region with local Room persistence.

states.empty: Enter patient details below to begin screening.
states.error: Required fields missing or invalid data format.

screens.layout: Form container with labeled text inputs, single-column layout, and sticky bottom CONTINUE button with safe area inset.

screens.name: Questionnaire
screens.purpose: Guided 17-question clinical screening with horizontal right-to-left slide transitions, conditional follow-ups, and answer preservation.
screens.layout: One question per screen view with smooth horizontal slide animation, progress indicator, choice cards, and sticky Back / Next controls.

screens.name: QuestionnaireReview
screens.purpose: Displays complete summary of all 17 questionnaire responses before initiating camera movement screening.
screens.layout: Scrollable review list grouped by category with edit shortcuts and a sticky START MOVEMENT ASSESSMENT button.

screens.name: AssessmentSetup
screens.purpose: Pre-assessment briefing showing instructions, patient summary, body region, and camera preparation guidelines.
screens.layout: Instructional card deck with numbered steps, compliance disclaimer, and sticky START CAMERA ASSESSMENT button.

screens.name: CameraAssessment
screens.purpose: Real-time CameraX and MediaPipe pose tracking capturing knee angles, ROM, angular velocity, cadence, symmetry, and quality metrics.

states.error: Both legs not visible in frame. Please adjust camera position.

screens.layout: Split-view layout featuring live camera preview (or 3D avatar view), real-time parameter tiles, assessment quality status indicators, and PAUSE/FINISH controls.

screens.name: AssessmentSummary
screens.purpose: Results summary screen showing movement measurements, personal baseline comparison, quality metrics, and required non-diagnostic disclaimers.
screens.layout: Card-based metric dashboard with ROM, cadence, step time, symmetry, baseline comparison, and mandatory referral-support disclaimer text.

screens.name: History
screens.purpose: Chronological list of all completed offline local assessments per patient with detail view access.

states.loading: Loading assessment history from Room database...

screens.layout: FlatList of assessment record cards showing date, region, test type, status, and detail chevron.

screens.name: Settings
screens.purpose: System configuration, offline database status, future BLE/IoT and ML model status overview, and data management.
screens.layout: Grouped setting rows with system status indicators, integration provider mock statuses, and local database storage management.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the offline Android OA Risk Detector app strictly adhering to the warm ivory/beige clinical palette, one-question-at-a-time horizontal questionnaire, real-time camera assessment metrics, Room database storage, 3D avatar viewport, and strict non-diagnostic medical disclaimers. Ensure all code compiles cleanly in Expo/React Native with zero mock AI diagnosis or internet dependencies.
